instruction: Mark "Taking a solo backpacking trip" in my Bucket List Simple Note as not done.
notes: Single-app task (simple_note). The supervisor's email (login username) is obtained via supervisor.show_profile and the password via supervisor.show_account_passwords. The Bucket List note id is discovered by search_notes with query 'bucket list' (effect known-id); show_note reads the current content (effect content-read), which is needed to build the updated content where only the checkbox of 'Taking a solo backpacking trip' is flipped from [x] to [ ]. update_note is called with note_id, access_token and the new content only (title/tags/pinned untouched, per the evaluation). The content object is a runtime value derived from show_note's response. supervisor-complete-task takes the target activity as a non-API record parameter so its precondition can mirror the goal; it is called with no answer (status success).
